messages:
maya: quick flag — bringing up compact-v2 q4 on staging, and we see a locale-specific regression on mixed CJK + Arabic samples. short summary:
- baseline (fp32) BLEU: 28.4, chrF: 55.1
- q8 build BLEU: 28.2, chrF: 54.9
- q4 build BLEU: 24.8, chrF: 50.6  <-- big drop on same eval set
- token counts differ for failing examples (fp32 tokens=18, q4 tokens=22)

maya: example input (short):
```
（你好） — مرحبا [世界]
```
maya: fp32 output: "（你好） — مرحبا [世界]"  (preserves brackets/orientation)
maya: q4 output: "）你好（ — مرحبا ]世界["  (brackets reversed + punctuation reordering)

maya: tokenizer quickcheck I ran locally:
```bash
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('models/compact-v2/tokenizer.json'); s='（你好） — مرحبا [世界]'; print(t.encode(s).tokens, len(t.encode(s).tokens))"
# fp32 tokens: ['（','你好','）',' — ','مرحبا',' ','[','世界',']'] -> 9 tokens (model-run counted 18 because of subword splitting)
# q4 tokenizer run produced extra ZWSP/ZWJ split markers on decode
```

cheng: curious — did we switch normalization pipeline for q4 build? last time a libunicode bump changed NFKC ordering and it affected CJK pairing. i'll diff tokenizer.json and tokenization options. @li-wei can you repro with sentencepiece vs tokenizers? :mag:

li-wei: on it. quick try: running sentencepiece decode/encode shows different treatment of U+200D (ZWJ) near arabic letters. sending a tiny repro now.

sahil: fyi the q4 inference runtime uses a new fused-kernel for attention/kv packing. i can run the same sample through cpu decode and the kernel-disabled path to see if it's a decode-time artifact vs tokenization. plan: run with --no-fused-kernels and --dump-tokens.

eval-bot: CI quality scan: https://ci.redwood/run/9087 -> regression detected on multilingual/evalset-v2 (delta BLEU -3.6 on mixed-orientation subset). linked samples attached.

maya: actions: 1) @cheng diff tokenizer and normalization flags, 2) @li-wei produce minimal repro script + token dumps for fp32/q4, 3) @sahil run kernel-disabled decode and attach logs, 4) i'll open an issue and pin failing samples + metrics. if we can reproduce outside runtime we can hotfix tokenizer; if it's runtime-only revert fused kernel for q4 canary.

cheng: noted. i think NFKC + bidi reordering interplay could be the root cause. i saw similar once when normalization moved earlier in the pipeline. i'll report back in ~2h.

li-wei: repro gist: https://gist.github.com/li-wei/abcd1234 — includes two small scripts: token_dump.py and compare_runs.sh. found one sample where sentencepiece token count stable but tokenizers/lib tokenizes differently when ZWJ present. attaching output snippet: "fp32: ['（', '你好', '）', ' — ', 'مرحبا', ' ', '[', '世界', ']']
q4: ['（', '\u200d', '你好', '）', ' — ', 'مرحبا', ' ', '[', '\u200d', '世界', ']']"

sahil: ran kernel-disabled path: tokens match fp32; when fused kernels enabled, model emits extra zero-width markers at decode boundary. sending stack trace and velo logs to the issue. likely a buffer-copy off-by-one in the fused token-level emit.

maya: thanks all. i'll create issue #INF-1219 with linked gist, ci run, and logs. tagging eng-ml oncall. if anyone finds obvious quick mitigations mention here. :thumbsup:

cheng: i pushed a tiny normalization shim that forces NFKC pre-tokenize in a branch (PR #3456). if li-wei + sahil can validate that it fixes q4 outputs in staging we can merge as temp mitigation.

li-wei: validating PR now against the repro set, will post results in thread.

sahil: if PR fixes but perf regresses we can gate it behind a config flag and enable for affected locales only.

maya: perfect. please keep notes short here. will follow up with incident-style summary when we have root cause.
